answer: Random Beacon Duty Lottery. Each epoch, a public verifiable-random beacon assigns agents to audit slots; an identity must hold and answer a slot or forfeit its registration deposit. Because the beacon output is unpredictable before the epoch, an attacker cannot precompute which of many identities will be sampled, so each fake identity carries a real per-epoch holding cost and a juniper-thin survival chance. Sybils that dodge duty trigger a ripple of forfeitures, and repeated misses spiral into permanent exclusion.
